rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root, not a candidate: the statements of configs/models/flex/wsp5/heptane/baseline-d2 (flex_heptane.wsp5) copied without change under spec flex_isooctane-wsp-v1 on droplet8.rs (the law of droplet6.rs for eight fuels); copied by the engineer (claude-opus-5-5), no number typed. It is the root of flex_isooctane.wsp7 because isooctane has no D^2-law reference of its own: phys_droplet_fuels.md section 3.1 makes the anchor's (heptane) baseline the lineage root; a candidate of this spec writes every authored element, so no number of this root survives in it.
